title: Barbecue Baked Beans
description: A flavorful baked beans recipe with smoked sausage, ground meat, and barbecue sauce.

ingredients.item: Whole bottle of Lovey's barbecue sauce

steps: Mix the butter, smoked sausage, barbecue sauce, onion, bell pepper, ground meat, salt, pepper, garlic powder, baked beans, Lovey's barbecue sauce, brown sugar, mustard, additional salt, garlic powder, and black pepper.
Let the mixture warm up for about 20 minutes.
notes:
Source: https://www.facebook.com/share/r/1AyNeAoJLw/

Nutrition: Serving 1 cup · Calories 250 · Fat 12g · Saturated fat 4g · Unsaturated fat 8g · Trans fat 0g · Cholesterol 40mg · Sodium 600mg · Carbs 35g · Fiber 5g · Sugar 15g · Protein 10g

healthy: Beans give fiber and plant protein.
Onion and green bell pepper add vegetables.
not_healthy: A bottle of BBQ sauce plus 1/2 cup brown sugar make it very high in sugar.
Smoked sausage is processed meat high in sodium and saturated fat.
A stick of butter and ground meat add more saturated fat.
